text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
Safety Precautions
A
 work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry
 the suitable safety category,
The
 circuit breaker must be isolated completely and grounded on both sides, i.e.
 earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker
 to ensure it is properly ground.
Wear your safety shoes and 
 helmet,
Change remote switch to local position,
Hydraulic system without pressure,
Interrupt the control circuit 
 DC volt.
Tools and Equipment
Safety shoes, Helmet, and dry wiper
Complete tool set and air blower.
Works to be Carried Out
Check the pressure of SF6 gas (6 bar),
Check the oil pressure (320 bar),
Record counter reading of operating counter,
Check the function of heater and check the door gasket of
 control cabinet,
Inspect break insulator and supporting isolator for
 pollution, cracks, and clean it with dry wiper,
Check all connection of the breaker,
Check the oil leak,
Check the priming pressure of nitrogen.
Lubricate the moving connection.
Check the gas leak
